description: Team from High School interested in Engineering and Videogames.
summary: Our team chose the challenge Abandoned but not Forgotten: storytelling about NASA’s Discarded Equipment on the Moon and Mars. With the objective of creating a story in which we encourage others to also learn about outer space and to push their creative side to the limit!
details: A story written and illustrated about space worms, aimed at a young audience, with the goal of raising awareness about outer space, its dimensions and to spark curiosity among enthusiasts interested in the equipment used by NASA.
